current_state.zh: Cloudflare has reworked its `cf` CLI for AI agents, expanding it from limited product coverage to all 3000+ Cloudflare API operations with JSON-default output, natural-language command search and TypeScript config, while disclosing that agents now make up 48% of Wrangler usage and planning to sunset Wrangler after one final major release.
